summary: Implemented S025 (US Index Overnight Drift, Confluence P12/S025+S026+S027 page 24838145): strategies/overnight_drift.py decomposes daily cash-to-cash return into overnight (open[t]/close[t-1]-1) and intraday legs with a gate0_no_look_ahead() regression check; 10 Gate 0 tests added in tests/strategies/test_overnight_drift.py (no-look-ahead, decomposition reconstructs exactly, cost strictly reduces equity). Found and handled a data-quality artifact while building backtest/run_overnight_drift.py: on data/raw/NASDAQ and data/raw/SP500 (composite-index proxies for the live NAS100/US500 CFDs), the 'open' column is backfilled equal to the prior close for most of older history (NASDAQ pre-2000-07-28, SP500 pre-2014-01-29 after fixing a first version of the detector that reported the wrong, too-early date by taking the first transient dip below threshold instead of the day after the LAST breach) -- added diagnose_open_data_quality() and made the runner clip to the detected clean window by default (--no-reliability-clip to disable). Honest E2 gross result on the clean window: overnight-only captures most of buy-and-hold's CAGR at much lower drawdown (SP500 2014-01-29..2026-08-14: overnight CAGR 7.46%/Sharpe 0.96/MaxDD -20.25%/WinRate 56.73%/12 of 13 years positive vs buy-and-hold CAGR 12.45%/Sharpe 0.76/MaxDD -33.92%; NASDAQ 2000-07-28..2026-08-14: overnight CAGR 7.80%/Sharpe 0.60/MaxDD -28.78% vs buy-and-hold CAGR 8.50%/Sharpe 0.44/MaxDD -80.37%). E3 cost sweep (0/1/2/3 bps round-trip per side, common 2014-01-29+ window) shows the edge is thin and cost-fragile: near breakeven around 1.5-2bps/side and clearly negative by 3bps on both indices -- consistent with the module's own factor-decay-after-publication caveat. No promotion decision made; still idea-stage per the registry/passport, now with a real (gross+costed) backtest attached instead of a formalized-rules-only spec.

Documented the S025 backtest (see the preceding overnight_drift entry) in Confluence per confluence-docs: Atlassian_Rovo MCP had only the Jira cloud granted this session (getAccessibleAtlassianResources returned just anton-mal-slb-jira), so used the REST-API fallback (JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN from .env, Confluence host anton-mal-slb.atlassian.net) via device_bash. Updated 'P12 / S025+S026+S027' page id 24838145 (v2->v3): inserted a dated subsection under the S025 heading with the E2 gross clean-window numbers, the open==prior-close data-quality finding, and an E3 cost-sensitivity note macro (breakeven ~1.5-2bps/side, negative by 3bps) -- merged into the existing storage-format body, did not touch the S026/S027 sections. Also appended a row to 'Апдейты (журнал работ)' page id 10584066 (v4->v5, table format, newest row on top) with the same summary and links back to this page and the change-log.
